sources.title: Llama Model Family — Model Architectures — A Visual History
sources.snippet: The Llama (Large Language Model Meta AI) series is Meta's flagship family of open-weight language models, spanning from a pure research release in February 2023 to a production-scale multimodal Mixture-of-Experts system in April 2025.

sources.title: Llama Versions — every Meta Llama model from LLaMA 1 through Llama 4 ...
sources.snippet: 2023 - 2026 Llama Versions Meta's current frontier-AI model is Muse Spark 1.2, released August 5, 2026 under Meta Superintelligence Labs — closed-weights, a coding-focused update to Muse Spark 1.1, co-trained with the Muse Code terminal agent that shipped the same day, with a 1M-token context window. It is callable through the Meta Model API.

sources.title: GitHub Pages - Baby
sources.snippet: Track update: This year introduces a dedicated MultiLingual track, and removes Multimodal and Interaction as standalone competition tracks, both are now subsumed into Strict / Strict-Small (paired image-text data and teacher-model feedback are allowed). Evaluation pipeline: The BabyLM 2026 evaluation pipeline is now ready!
